title: sdk: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go; version bumps
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: developers saw inconsistent auth behavior, retry policies, and streaming ergonomics across our three official SDKs which caused surprising edge-case failures and caller ergonomics regressions. This PR unifies the auth token refresh contract, standardizes automatic retry/backoff behavior, and provides a consistent streaming client API surface across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Changes include: 1) Auth: introduce a single TokenProvider interface and helper implementations (static API key, refresh token, and KMS-backed provider). SDKs now call provider.get_token() and automatically attach Authorization headers, with an opt-out for manual token management. 2) Retries: unify retry policy defaults (idempotency checks, max attempts=4, exponential backoff with jitter, and per-method override hooks). Network and 5xx server errors are retried; 4xx client errors are not retried by default except 429 which uses a dedicated backoff. 3) Streaming ergonomics: add a unified streaming client abstraction that exposes a single iterator/async iterator in each language, consistent event types (data, progress, error, end), and a unified reconnect+resume strategy for transient failures. 4) Parity and ergonomics: align method names and parameter ordering across SDKs for core surfaces (generate, chat, embeddings). 5) Version bumps: bump Python to 1.7.0, TypeScript to 0.9.3, Go client to 0.6.1 and update changelogs. 6) Tests and docs: add cross-language integration tests that exercise token rotation and retry/resume flows, and update README snippets and migration notes. Checklist: [x] TokenProvider spec and helpers implemented in all SDKs [x] Retry defaults applied and configurable [x] Streaming client API added and documented [x] Integration tests for token rotation and reconnect [x] Changelogs updated [x] CI green and package versions bumped Backwards compatibility: default behavior is backwards compatible for most users; an opt-out path via legacy_auth=true and legacy_retries=true is provided for customers who depend on previous semantics. Rollout: staged release with feature gates for Dedicated/private instances for 72 hours before wide rollout. See linked Linear and release notes for more details.

release_notes: SDKs: unified auth TokenProvider, standardized retry/backoff defaults (max_attempts=4), new streaming client with reconnect/resume support, and version bumps: Python 1.7.0, TypeScript 0.9.3, Go 0.6.1. Migration: see docs/sdk-migration/auth-and-retries.md for opt-out flags and examples.
notes: Staged rollout; feature gates enabled for Dedicated/private for initial 72h. Ops notified to monitor retries and error-rate dashboards.
